summary: CAIR Action, which weighs Gaza/ceasefire positions alongside civil rights in its recommendations, endorsed Tovar at the full endorsement tier in the 2026 Gilroy general election. The CAIR Action endorsement is the documented connection between Tovar and Palestinian justice in this record.
